'''AF1 Armor Fragger''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>ATK</b>: {{Color|17252|7}}<br>
<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Fires a flaming jet to attack approaching enemies. The flaming jet deals {{Color|Heat DMG|3}} over time to enemies within range.|A combat facility that can project jets of fire. It uses a fuel comprising a mixture of various flammable liquids. The power to set everything aflame reminds people of the merciless infernos often described in Terran history.}}
